subject: Setting: the Hades underworld realm, a colossal weathered gate carved from black basalt, dark misty river, drifting ash.
style: Photorealistic grim dark fantasy AAA game asset reference in the spirit of Dark Souls and Elden Ring: restrained palette, cold desaturated ash-grey light only, no orange or warm point lights, no stray glowing spots, believable weathered stone, wet surfaces, fine material detail, sharp, ultra detailed, no characters, no text, not cartoon, not stylised, no neon.

rows.name: gate_front_elevation
rows.prompt: Straight-on front elevation of the colossal basalt gate, perfectly symmetrical, centred, entire gate visible from base to top, flat even overcast lighting, plain dark grey background, orthographic game-asset reference.

rows.name: gate_arch_detail
rows.prompt: Close-up of the gate arch and keystone with deep relief carvings of tormented figures and runes, cracks, dry weathered basalt, raking light.

rows.name: causeway_floor_tile
rows.prompt: Top-down flat seamless tileable texture of cracked wet black basalt flagstones with ash and fine dust in the joints, evenly lit, no perspective, material reference.

rows.name: ground_ash_tile
